text: 환자별로 첫 경피관상동맥중재술(PCI) 시술일을 기준시점으로 하고, 기준시점이 속한 자료 관찰 기간에서 기준시점 이후 14일 이내 사망일 또는 자료 관찰 종료일 중 먼저 발생하는 시점까지 추적하되, 둘 다 없으면 14일 종료일로 추적 종료일과 종료 사유를 집계하여 산출하라.
gold: WITH index_dates AS ( select po.person_id, min(po.procedure_date) as index_date from procedure_occurrence po where po.procedure_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4216130)) group by po.person_id ), follow_up_candidates AS ( SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date, i.index_date + INTERVAL '14' DAY AS maximum_follow_up_date FROM index_dates i JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.death_date >= i.index_date AND d.death_date <= i.index_date + INTERVAL '14' DAY ) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.death_date WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.observation_period_end_date ELSE f.maximum_follow_up_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'DEATH' WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'OBSERVATION_END' ELSE '14_DAY_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;
